title: exam_state
description: The agent's exam mode state, sent after connecting and whenever it changes (entering, leaving at `until`, leaving because the capability was switched off locally). The server keeps it per exam and device. `enabled: true` while the lab has no running exam is answered with `exam_mode` `enabled: false`; `enabled: false` while the lab's exam runs (more than 20 seconds after the last `exam_mode` sent and more than a minute before `until`) counts as leaving early: audit entry and notification. Never the first message of a connection.

enabled.description: Whether exam mode is applied on the device now. A non-boolean value makes the server ignore the message.

since.description: Unix seconds when the current state began (entered or left exam mode). Kept only between the years 2000 and 2100.

until.description: Unix seconds of the end of the applied exam (`exam_mode.until`); null or absent when not in exam mode.
